question: Where was the Bharatiya Bhasha Anubhag (Indian Languages Section) launched by Union Home Minister Amit Shah on 6 June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bharatiya Bhasha Anubhag (Indian Languages Section)** was launched by Union Home Minister **Amit Shah** on **6 June 2025** to promote Indian languages.
 
• It was inaugurated at **New Delhi**, which serves as the administrative capital of India and a hub for major policy launches and initiatives.
 
• The initiative aims to **encourage the use and development of Indian languages** in education, administration, and everyday life to preserve India’s linguistic heritage.
 
• The program aligns with the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, which emphasizes the importance of regional languages for better learning outcomes and cultural preservation.
 
• The Indian Languages Section is intended to function as a **dedicated department** for research, development, and promotion of Indian languages, fostering a sense of unity in diversity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Importance of New Delhi:**

 
 
• **New Delhi** is India’s national capital and a central location for government offices, ministries, and international organizations.
 
• It is often chosen as the venue for launching significant national-level initiatives and schemes.
 
 
 
• **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020:**
 
 
• The NEP 2020 advocates the use of **mother tongue/regional languages** as the medium of instruction up to at least Grade 5, and preferably till Grade 8 and beyond.
 
• It encourages the development and promotion of **Indian languages, arts, and culture** to ensure India’s rich heritage is preserved.
 
 
 
• **Indian Languages in Focus:**
 
 
• India is home to **22 officially recognized languages** under the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution and hundreds of regional and tribal languages.
 
• The launch of the **Bharatiya Bhasha Anubhag** aims to support these languages through research, digitization, and promotion efforts.
 
 
 
• **Steps to Promote Indian Languages:**
 
 
• Government initiatives like the **Ek Bharat Shreshtha Bharat** program promote cultural and linguistic exchange among states.
 
• Technology-driven solutions, such as **AI-based translation tools**, are being developed to bridge language barriers.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Union Home Minister Amit Shah's Role:**

 
 
• Amit Shah has been actively promoting the use of **Hindi and regional languages** as part of the government’s efforts to preserve India’s linguistic diversity.
 
• He has also emphasized the use of Indian languages in governance and education to strengthen national integration.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Bharatiya Bhasha Anubhag:**
 
 
• The initiative is expected to create more resources, including **books and digital content**, in regional languages.
 
• It will foster inclusivity and ensure that people from diverse linguistic backgrounds feel represented and valued.
 
• This program is likely to benefit **students, scholars, and the general public** by providing access to education and information in their native languages.
